reviews.title: More like SCAMCoin
reviews.text: Yet another shady app that somehow keeps sneaking charges LONG AFTER I cancelled the subscription. Apple is even hassling me about correcting the situation. So to sum up, if you want an app that shows up under your “inactive subscriptions” list but KEEPS CHARGING you, this is the app you want!
I forgot to cancel the free trial, this app charged me 10.82 a WEEK since FEBRUARY 25TH 2025! 876.42!!The app isn’t even installed on the phone I currently have. Learned a costly lesson.

reviews.title: Just awful
reviews.text: They hide the subscription so you can’t cancel during the trial period then they try to charge you 50 dollars. I had to call Apple support and they had a hard time finding it because they do such a great job scamming people by hiding their subscription. If I can give it negative stars I would because now I have to wait 48 hours to be able to download any apps on my phone. Oh and if you go on the app there is no way of cancelling it on their either.
